ui.agents.dialogs.create.title.length_hint: Short title beside an agent icon
ui.agents.dialogs.create.title.note: Creates a blank local agent, unlike importing a saved archive.

ui.agents.dialogs.create.cancel.note: Closes without creating the agent; this dialog retains its current entered fields until a successful creation.

ui.agents.dialogs.create.submit.role: Submit button creating a local agent
ui.agents.dialogs.create.submit.length_hint: Small primary footer button with optional spinner
ui.agents.dialogs.create.submit.note: Disabled while saving or when the trimmed name is empty. Sends the entered name/description unchanged.

ui.agents.dialogs.create.intro.tone: Plain instruction addressed to the creator
ui.agents.dialogs.create.intro.length_hint: One paragraph within a small dialog
ui.agents.dialogs.create.intro.note: The name is required; description is optional. Do not imply a description is required.

ui.agents.dialogs.create.hub_link.role: Link button from creation dialog to Agent hub
ui.agents.dialogs.create.hub_link.length_hint: One link-style row with external-link icon
ui.agents.dialogs.create.hub_link.note: Closes the dialog and navigates to the hub to fetch ready-made agents, rather than submitting creation.

ui.agents.dialogs.create.name_label.note: Names the local agent identity field, not the operator or model.

ui.agents.dialogs.create.name_hint.length_hint: Single-line input hint, about 26 English characters
ui.agents.dialogs.create.name_hint.note: The name field receives initial focus; real names entered by the user are not translated.

ui.agents.dialogs.create.description_lab.note: Parenthesized optional marker is part of this label, not a separate placeholder.

ui.agents.dialogs.create.description_hin.note: Descriptions are authored text about what the agent does; entered content remains unchanged.

ui.agents.dialogs.menu.accessible.role: Accessible name of agent-options icon button
ui.agents.dialogs.menu.accessible.note: Lowercase English is preserved. Opens the menu without selecting the underlying agent row.

ui.agents.dialogs.menu.chat.role: Options-menu item starting chat with this agent
ui.agents.dialogs.menu.chat.length_hint: Compact menu row beside chat icon
ui.agents.dialogs.menu.chat.note: Offered on the agents page; uses the existing chat callback.

ui.agents.dialogs.menu.settings.role: Options-menu navigation item for agent settings
ui.agents.dialogs.menu.settings.length_hint: Compact menu row beside settings icon
ui.agents.dialogs.menu.settings.note: Shown outside the agents page, where settings are not already open.

ui.agents.dialogs.menu.export.length_hint: Compact menu row beside file-output icon
ui.agents.dialogs.menu.export.note: Downloads a ZIP archive for the chosen agent; it does not publish or delete it.

ui.agents.dialogs.menu.upload.length_hint: Compact menu row beside upload icon
ui.agents.dialogs.menu.upload.note: Opens the hub upload dialog when that callback exists; not a local archive import.

ui.agents.dialogs.menu.clear.role: Warning options-menu item opening conversation-clear confirmation
ui.agents.dialogs.menu.clear.note: Only opens the confirmation. The conversation is deleted only after explicit confirmation.

ui.agents.dialogs.menu.delete.role: Destructive options-menu item opening agent-delete confirmation
ui.agents.dialogs.menu.delete.note: Only opens the confirmation. Agent deletion also removes all of its conversations.

ui.agents.dialogs.delete.title.note: Names agent deletion, distinct from clearing one conversation.

ui.agents.dialogs.delete.warning.length_hint: Two sentences below the confirmation question; wraps
ui.agents.dialogs.delete.warning.note: All conversations with the agent are permanently deleted. Both irreversibility and scope must remain explicit.

ui.agents.dialogs.delete.confirm.note: Runs deletion only after the person confirms. Never translate as a vague acceptance label.

ui.agents.dialogs.delete.cancel.note: Closes the confirmation and leaves the agent/conversations intact.

ui.agents.dialogs.clear.title.length_hint: Short modal heading with question mark
ui.agents.dialogs.clear.title.note: Clears the current conversation, not the agent definition.

ui.agents.dialogs.clear.warning.length_hint: Two sentences in modal body; wraps
ui.agents.dialogs.clear.warning.note: Deletes every message from this computer with no undo, but leaves the agent itself unaffected.

ui.agents.dialogs.clear.confirm.note: Confirms the existing clear-conversation callback; does not delete the agent.

ui.agents.dialogs.clear.cancel.note: Closes without deleting any conversation messages.

ui.agents.dialogs.import.title.note: Opens an archive picker to create/import an agent from a saved export.

ui.agents.dialogs.import.cancel.note: Closes and resets the selected file and validation error without importing.

ui.agents.dialogs.import.submit.length_hint: Small primary footer button with optional spinner
ui.agents.dialogs.import.submit.note: Disabled until a file is selected and while the import request runs.

ui.agents.dialogs.import.intro.tone: Explain accepted archive and required file
ui.agents.dialogs.import.intro.length_hint: Two sentences within a small dialog; wraps
ui.agents.dialogs.import.intro.note: ZIP and agent.yml are literal format/file identifiers and must stay unchanged. The archive is an export from Local Operator.

ui.agents.dialogs.import.replace_file.role: Dropzone hint after a file is selected
ui.agents.dialogs.import.replace_file.length_hint: Short secondary line below unchanged filename
ui.agents.dialogs.import.replace_file.note: Click chooses another archive; dropping a new file replaces the selection, not an already installed agent.

ui.agents.dialogs.import.drop_file.length_hint: One centered line beside upload icon
ui.agents.dialogs.import.drop_file.note: ZIP names the archive format; selecting a file does not import until submit.

ui.agents.dialogs.import.choose_file.note: Clicking opens the system file chooser as an alternative to drag and drop.

ui.agents.dialogs.delete.question.role: Confirmation question naming agent to delete
ui.agents.dialogs.delete.question.length_hint: One body paragraph; may wrap for a long name
ui.agents.dialogs.delete.question.note: The name is surrounded by literal straight double quotes. Do not soften or omit the deletion verb.

placeholders.name: Unchanged display name of the agent being deleted, interpolated between literal straight double quotes; never translate the actual name.

ui.agents.dialogs.import.invalid_zip.length_hint: One short alert below the dropzone
ui.agents.dialogs.import.invalid_zip.note: Shown when the chosen filename does not end in .zip (case-insensitive). The stored state is the key so an active error refreshes when locale changes.
